name: Fibery
description: Your Fibery tasks and projects on the calendar, from any database with a date field. Move one here (drag it, or Move) and its date changes in Fibery; change it in Fibery and the calendar follows within a minute.

messages.needs-setup: Add your Fibery workspace and API key in the plugin settings.
messages.choose-database: Choose a task or project database in the plugin settings.
messages.task-database-gone: The chosen task database is no longer in Fibery. Choose it again in the settings.
messages.project-database-gone: The chosen project database is no longer in Fibery. Choose it again in the settings.
messages.task-date-missing: Choose which date field puts a task on the calendar.
messages.project-date-missing: Choose which date field puts a project on the calendar.
messages.task-date-gone: The chosen task date field is no longer a date field in Fibery. Choose another.
messages.project-date-gone: The chosen project date field is no longer a date field in Fibery. Choose another.
messages.key-refused: Fibery didn't accept the API key. Check it in the plugin settings; the calendar keeps what it last had.
messages.unreachable: Couldn't reach Fibery on the last try. It tries again every minute; the calendar keeps what it last had.
messages.busy: Fibery asked for a pause (too many requests). It tries again in a minute.
messages.refused: Fibery refused a request. Check the chosen databases and fields in the plugin settings.
messages.too-many: A database has more dated items than one run reads, so only the first 3,000 show.
